in_marathi.name: Atisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wisdom, Precious, Serene
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Atisha (अतिशा) is a Sanskrit name meaning 'precious, invaluable, and serene'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ati' (beyond) and 'isha' (lord). In Hindu mythology, Atisha is revered as a great master of Mahayana Buddhism. He is known for his profound wisdom and is considered an embodiment of compassion and enlightenment.
